Definition: Caleb, the name of three Israelites
BiblicalUsage: Caleb = "dog"; 1) the godly son of Jephunneh and the faithful spy who reported the Promised Land favourably and urged its capture; 2) son of Hezron and grandson of Pharez and great grandson of Judah and the father of Hur and grandfather of Caleb the spy
